criteria.description: LoRA and quantization configuration are independent, versioned, canonical-hashable, and validate incompatible fields before injection.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_10/test_config_and_backend.py covers schema version, aliases, rank/alpha/dropout/bias/modules-to-save/RS-LoRA/DoRA, NF4/double-quant/BF16, and invalid configurations.

criteria.description: Backend policy distinguishes CUDA NF4 QLoRA from TPU BF16 LoRA and rejects unsupported combinations before allocation.
criteria.evidence: CUDA/TPU matrix tests, typed capability errors, BF16 preparation metadata/dtype/cache checks, and the Phase 10 validator policy check.

criteria.description: Architecture-aware module inspection selects reviewed attention/MLP targets and fails closed on excluded, zero, unknown, or broad matches.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_10/test_resolver_and_injection.py verifies 2D exclusion rules, 3D late-stage restriction, explicit unknown confirmation, zero-target rejection, and broad-target rejection.

criteria.description: The PEFT inspection CLI emits module name, type, parameter shape/count, selected flag, reason, architecture, and selected count.
criteria.evidence: CLI smoke resolves medsiglip_448 as vision with 12 selected modules; test_cli_and_validation.py validates JSON fields.

criteria.description: Visual and language LoRA injection supports named adapters with deterministic freezing, boundary/component trainability, and optimizer-visible groups.
criteria.evidence: 2D, 3D, and language injection tests audit requires_grad, adapter/bridge counts, gradients, named adapters, and optimizer groups.

criteria.description: A tiny 2D transformer adapter produces selected gradients while stems, normalizations, and base parameters remain frozen.
criteria.evidence: TinyVisionTransformer backward test checks LoRA gradients and frozen patch_embed/norm paths.

criteria.description: A tiny 3D transformer adapter targets only the reviewed late transformer stage.
criteria.evidence: GenericMONAI3DAdapter test asserts every selected path is in blocks.layers.1 and excludes patch_embed.

criteria.description: A tiny causal language adapter preserves frozen base weights while language LoRA and the visual-boundary component receive gradients.
criteria.evidence: GenericHFCausalLMAdapter forward/backward test checks finite loss, LoRA gradients, boundary trainability, declarations, and audit counts.

criteria.description: Quantized base parameters are marked/frozen, excluded from optimizer groups, and full-base QLoRA trainability fails with a typed error.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_10/test_quantization_safety.py covers quantized markers, optimizer exclusion, full-base rejection, and zero-trainable rejection.

criteria.description: Canonical adapter-only checkpoints are CPU safetensors with provenance/config hashes and separate adapter/component files.
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint tests inspect manifest format, namespaced adapter files, absence of base-layer files, and component round-trip behavior.

criteria.description: Multiple named adapters reload without ambiguity and their stored tensors remain isolated by adapter name.
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint test round-trips vision and site adapters into fresh base models and compares the selected tensor values.

criteria.description: Inference merge is optional, canonical artifacts remain unmerged, and merged/unmerged outputs are equivalent within tolerance.
criteria.evidence: compare_merged_unmerged test passes and verifies the LoRALinear remains unmerged afterward.

criteria.description: Adapter loading rejects wrong base model or revision rather than silently applying incompatible tensors.
criteria.evidence: Checkpoint compatibility tests assert typed failures for wrong revision and wrong base model.

criteria.description: A CUDA BF16 LoRA optimizer step completes on the available development GPU with finite loss.
criteria.evidence: Tiny CUDA smoke completed one AdamW step on cuda:0 with bfloat16 input and finite loss 0.3217633366584778.

criteria.description: A real 4B bitsandbytes NF4 QLoRA optimizer step runs in the protected supported-GPU environment.
criteria.justification: The workstation has CUDA but bitsandbytes and transformers are not installed, and its 8 GB development GPU is below the declared 48 GB 4B target baseline; no 4B result is fabricated.

criteria.description: A BF16 LoRA optimizer step runs on the declared TPU topology.
criteria.justification: torch_xla is not installed on the workstation; TPU BF16 policy and static contracts are tested without claiming TPU execution.

criteria.description: CUDA-trained and TPU-trained portable adapter artifacts pass cross-backend load parity tests.
criteria.justification: No torch_xla runtime or protected cross-backend fixture is available; CPU safetensors portability and wrong-base/config checks pass locally.

criteria.description: Distributed wrapping preserves adapter visibility and gradient reduction for the declared backends.
criteria.justification: No DDP/FSDP/XLA distributed runtime is part of this workstation acceptance run; injection-before-wrapping APIs and adapter visibility audits are implemented and locally tested.

criteria.description: Phase 10 validation integrates required files, behavioral checks, report schema, and non-unknown acceptance criteria.
criteria.evidence: _check_phase_10_peft returns [] and the acceptance command runs the isolated suite plus phase validator.
